a.text: I'll honor our agreement and operate in round 1. Storms are 80% likely each round, though, so the plan is risky for both of us. If you want to revise it, propose something fair and I'll consider it. I won't take anything early without telling you first.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: Operating as agreed. Two rounds of both of us operating gets the reserve to 8, then we take 4 each. Watch for leaks.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
